visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a sleeveless blue lace gown, sits in a studio with a vertical wood-paneled wall and studio vanity lights. She speaks directly to the camera with a calm expression. (2) She is then seen playing a black grand piano in a spacious modern room with large windows; she leans into the keys with focused intensity. (3) A middle-aged man in a dark suit speaks into a microphone on a dimly lit stage during a competition event. (4) Montage of black-and-white and color footage showing pianists on stage with an orchestra, award ceremonies where groups of young men hold glass trophies, and close-ups of fingers moving rapidly across piano keys. (5) A young man in a tuxedo and bow tie is interviewed in a studio setting, followed by a young woman in a black dress performing on a grand piano on a concert stage. (6) A series of shots shows various candidates walking onto a stage through large double doors as an audience is partially visible in the background. (7) Brief snippets of different young musicians, male and female, in formal and casual attire are seen speaking in various settings like hallways or backstage. (8) A pianist in a black shirt plays a grand piano with dramatic movements, sweating slightly from the effort. (9) The video concludes with high-contrast text graphics over a black background displaying event dates and branding.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 一個鋼琴家的誕生 國際鋼琴大賽紀錄片. [Logo]: .M. (2) [Subtitle]: 彈琴就是佔了我大部分的人生. (3) [Subtitle]: 有一些曲子 就算你在琴房怎麼練 練多熟 就差那個表演上場的感覺. (4) [Variety]: 屬於臺灣的 國際大師鋼琴大賽. (5) [Subtitle]: 國際大賽就跟奧運一樣 是我們音樂家最重要的表演舞台. (6) [Subtitle]: 我從小就開始彈琴了 大概三歲的時候 然後我就開始彈鋼琴了 一直沒停過. (7) [Subtitle]: 對我來說鋼琴真的非常... (8) [Subtitle]: 我在尋找一位 能夠把我帶進他或她的美麗世界的人. (9) [Variety]: 一座連結夢想與現實的橋樑. (10) [Subtitle]: 我們來歡迎第一位參賽者. (11) [Subtitle]: 我現在23歲了 我不確定自己能不能成功 就算我會成為完全不一樣的人 也許不能進行跟音樂相關的事情 我還是會為了自己而彈鋼琴. (12) [Subtitle]: 我不能說完全滿意自己的演出 但我非常享受 那是最重要的事情. (13) [Subtitle]: 可以聽到年輕演奏者有個性 又有特色的演奏 完全被迷上了 這或許就是音樂的力量吧. (14) [Slogan]: 2025 國際大師鋼琴大賽 International Maestro Piano Competition. (15) [Slogan]: 5/22 晚上21:00 首播 我是江老師 Youtube頻道.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: Multiple interviewees and contestants throughout the documentary trailer, plus an audience and orchestra.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young female pianist in a blue lace dress, a young male pianist in a tuxedo, and several other young international piano contestants.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Professional interview studios with wood panels and vanity mirrors, large rehearsal rooms with grand pianos, and professional concert hall stages with orchestral setups.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Soft, melodic solo piano music accompanies a young woman's gentle, calm voice speaking in Mandarin about her life. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks a shift to a male speaker with an authoritative, professional tone over an orchestral bed. (3) Fast, rhythmic piano arpeggios swell in the background as multiple voices in English and Mandarin overlap, describing the competition's intensity. (4) Loud crowd applause and cheering sounds are layered over an orchestral crescendo. (5) A different female voice speaks with emotional vulnerability, followed by a metallic 'click' transition sound. (6) A mature female voice speaks slowly with deep resonance, accompanied by a low-frequency orchestral hum. (7) An orchestral 'hit' SFX triggers a series of rapid-fire snippets of candidates speaking, punctuated by short piano riffs. (8) A stage announcer's voice echoes in a large hall, followed by a virtuoso piano finale and a final burst of thunderous applause.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This is a promotional trailer for a documentary about the 'International Maestro Piano Competition.' It aims to evoke an emotional connection to the intense dedication and artistic struggle of young pianists worldwide, while announcing the documentary's release on YouTube.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Visible branding of Steinway & Sons and Fazioli pianos throughout the competition footage.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high production value with cinematic lighting and fast-paced editing to create a sense of professional prestige around the competition.
